importRules: APPROVED means source identity pairing allowed, subject to exact pinned USDA row replay, field provenance and V4 append-only checks
Do not import HELD, REJECTED or UNRESOLVED
Join approved targetId and fdcId only against exact original candidate entries and pinned source, do not infer dataset/release/title from this verdict file
All qualifying review boundaries in reason must be carried into approved source-match-table stateEvidence/rationale
No automated production Firestore writes, rules changes, writer flags or paid APIs authorized
